facts.conditions: deterministic application defect: TVS2 sits on the +5 V output rail and the SD05 VRWM is exactly 5.0 V, so the standoff margin at the nominal rail voltage is 0 V. Any positive rail tolerance (the L7805 output tolerance band alone), ripple, or thermal drift puts the rail at or above the rated standoff, where leakage rises ahead of the 6 V minimum breakdown. This is the defect that motivates the TVS2 replacement-candidate research recorded in this bundle; part selection is deferred to the decision task.
